h1: Golf Carts for Sale in On Top of The World
lead: Live in On Top of The World? Need a golf cart? Masters Golf Cars has been helping OTOW folks since 1999. We sell new and used carts that work great in your community.
Our shop is at 12885 S US Highway 441 in Belleview. Take SR-200 east and you will find us in about 15 minutes. We sell Club Car, Yamaha, and EZ-GO. We also fix carts and rent them.

sections.h2: Why OTOW Folks Buy From Masters Golf Cars

p: On Top of The World is a big place. Over 10,000 homes. Miles of paths. Golf courses. The Recreation Center. Circle Square Commons. The Town Square. We know you need a cart that can handle it all. We have been selling to OTOW for 26 years.

Golf carts are not just for golf here. People use them to go to the pool, the gym, shops, and to see friends. OTOW has paths all over. A cart saves you time. It is fun too. We help you find the right one.
From OTOW, take SW 80th Street to SR-200 East. Then go south on US-441. We are on the right, across from the Market of Marion. The whole drive takes about 15 minutes.

cards.h: Places You Can Go by Cart in OTOW

p: Do not want to pay all at once? We work with Sheffield Financial. You can pay month by month. Low payments. Easy to apply.

sections.h2: Top Golf Cart Brands for OTOW
intro: We sell the best names in golf carts. Each brand works great for life in On Top of The World. Come see them at our shop.

p: Comfy and strong. Many OTOW folks pick Club Car. Works great for daily trips around the community.
Good battery range. Smooth ride. Yamaha carts get you from one end of OTOW to the other with no trouble.
Good price. Runs well for years. Lots of OTOW folks drive an EZ-GO. Hard to beat the value.
Want a cart with zero miles? We have new ones from the top brands. They come with full warranties. You can pick colors and options.

sections.h2: About On Top of The World
intro: On Top of The World is one of the biggest 55+ spots in Florida. It sits in Marion County near Ocala. Over 10,000 homes. Three golf courses. Pools. Gyms. Clubs for every hobby you can think of.
Circle Square Commons has shops, a movie theater, and places to eat. The Town Square has live music most weekends. People love it here. And most of them get around by golf cart.
Paths connect the whole place. Go from your house to the pool. Visit friends in other neighborhoods. Head to dinner. A golf cart makes it all easy and fun.
